finalModelMessage:
I was unable to complete the registration. The "Register" controls on the `/inaccessible` page for "Building Accessible Forms in Java" are rendered as plain, non-interactive text (with unlabeled `img` elements nearby) rather than as an actual accessible button or link with the name "Register". My tools operate strictly via accessible roles/names, and attempts to click it as a `button`, `link`, or `img` all timed out because no such accessible element exists in the tree.

**Result: Registration could not be started.** The page's "Register" action has no exposed accessible role/name (it appears to be a non-semantic element, e.g., a `div`/`span` with a click handler and no ARIA role), so it cannot be located or activated using role-based accessible interactions. This is exactly the kind of accessibility failure this page seems designed to demonstrate — I could not proceed to the name/email form, meal preference, or terms checkbox, and therefore have no confirmation code to report.
